about: What a pipeline job may skip and stay green (scripts/ci/skip_guard.py; docs/ci.md, 'A skip nobody recorded'). One entry per reason pytest prints. kind: 'design' when no machine runs the test, 'image' when this job's image cannot and another place does (runs_in names the job; otherwise the why says a desk does). A test the job could run is not recorded here: the job is given what the test needs. deploy/tests/test_pipeline.py pins the shape.

skips.reason: Hermes is not importable here
skips.why: The approval hook is driven through Hermes's own plugin interface; the slim Python image has no Hermes.

skips.reason: the provider ABC ships with Hermes; skipped where none is installed
skips.why: The bwrap provider is checked against Hermes's base class, which only an install has.

skips.reason: no Hermes install beside this checkout
skips.why: The message plugin is loaded into a real Hermes; the slim Python image has none.

skips.reason: the memory tools' own schemas ship with Hermes; skipped where none is installed
skips.why: The table of memory actions the gate classifies is held against the installed memory tool's schema, which only an install has (T-1490).

skips.reason: ffmpeg is not on this machine
skips.why: The recording tool's tests against the real ffmpeg; installing it takes a minute, so one job does.

skips.reason: ffmpeg and ffprobe are not both on this host; the image has them (deploy/Dockerfile)
skips.why: The media conversion against the real tools; installing them takes a minute, so one job does.

skips.reason: Hermes not importable here
skips.why: The gateway's platform list is read from a real Hermes. A prefix: the reason ends with the import error.

skips.reason: no Hermes install on this machine; the recorded list is the check
skips.why: The plugin manifest is compared with what a real Hermes lists; here the recorded list stands in.

skips.reason: root can list any directory
skips.why: A file mode does not keep root out and every job is root; the job named runs it as nobody.

skips.reason: root can read anything
skips.why: A file mode does not keep root out and every job is root; the job named runs it as nobody.

skips.reason: root writes through any mode
skips.why: A file mode does not keep root out and every job is root; the job named runs it as nobody.

skips.reason: root can list anything; the mode below would not bite
skips.why: A file mode does not keep root out and every job is root; the job named runs it as nobody.

skips.reason: docker compose is not installed here
skips.why: Checks the installer's compose file with the real Docker CLI, which the slim image has not; a desk runs it.

skips.reason: needs docker compose to read the file
skips.why: The cold-start drill's dry run reads the house's compose file with the real Docker CLI, which the slim image has not; a desk runs it.

skips.reason: the house's address is unknown here (no host env, as in CI)
skips.why: Searches the tree for the house's own address, read from the host's env file, which no job may have; a desk runs it.

skips.reason: the home domain is unknown here (no host env, as in CI)
skips.why: Searches the tree for the home domain, read from the host's env file, which no job may have; a desk runs it.

skips.reason: live proof: needs a Hermes install and ~1 minute; set AURA_LIVE_WEBHOOK_PROOF=1
skips.why: An opt-in live proof that starts a gateway; run by hand when the webhook path changes.

skips.reason: live proof: needs a Hermes install and several minutes; set AURA_LIVE_CRON_PROOF=1
skips.why: An opt-in live proof that waits on real cron ticks; run by hand when the cron path changes.

skips.reason: live proof: needs a Hermes install and ~1 minute; set AURA_LIVE_TELEGRAM_PROOF=1
skips.why: An opt-in live proof: a real gateway against a stand-in for the provider's host; run by hand when that path changes.

skips.reason: live proof: needs a built image and a Docker daemon; set AURA_LIVE_PDF_PROOF=1
skips.why: An opt-in live proof inside the built image; run by hand when the document reader changes.

skips.reason: llama-swap binary not available
skips.why: Runs only where the models server's own binary is installed, which is the models image and no test machine.

skips.reason: voice states come from the microphone path, which the console has none of
skips.why: Cells of a table shared with the web console that do not apply to the desktop's console.

skips.reason: warming counts only while a turn waits on it (the web's reading)
skips.why: Cells of a table shared with the web console that do not apply to the desktop's console.

skips.reason: the contract carries no example for
skips.why: A card type the shared contract has no example of yet. A prefix: the reason ends with the type's name.

skips.reason: no .private-values here: names, places and bare hosts are checked only on a machine that has one
skips.why: A machine's own names and places are a list that is never tracked, so no pipeline has one; the seven shape classes run here, and a desk that has the list runs this.

skips.reason: pwsh is not installed here
skips.why: install.ps1 is run for real only at a desk that has PowerShell: no pipeline image has it, and no desk has run it yet (GAPS G44). Its shape (one function, the last line, the hand-over) is read by tests that do run here.
